items.title_zh: FII Institute 发布报告：如何把企业 AI 投资转化为业务价值

items.why_en: It shows AI meeting hardware integrating with office ecosystems becoming a consumer product.

items.title_zh: 阿里千问发布 QwenGyre，面向超长程智能体任务的在线强化学习框架
items.title_en: Alibaba's Qwen Releases QwenGyre, an Online RL Framework for Ultra-Long-Horizon Agent Tasks
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 12 日消息，阿里千问今日正式发布 QwenGyre，这是一款面向长程智能体任务的在线强化学习框架。 据官方介绍，当智能体承担复杂工作，一次执行往往持续数小时，模型与环境之间有数百轮相互依赖的交互，累计处理百万级 token。QwenGyre 通过弹性调度与轨迹处理， 让这类超长程任务成为有效的训练来源 ， 同时带来能力与效率提升 。 QwenGyre 能够把 GPU 分成若干计算单元，任务每结束一批，空出的单元就转入训练，就像项目组里谁先交差、谁先加入复盘。还在跑的任务完全不受打扰，进度和状态原地保留，连之前算过的缓存都整体搬走，不必重头再来。新空出的单元直接加入本轮训练，谁算得快谁多干，最后由核心单元汇总结果，完成一次参数更新。 IT之家注意到，QwenGyre 可通过 Token-in Token-out 记录每段输出生成时的真实上下文，按共享前缀组织成轨迹树，只把被选中的路径展开为训练样本。同时，超时但部分完成的任务也能通过 Partial Scoring 提供有用反馈，不浪费任何一步努力。 跑分方面，官方在 NL2RepoBench 在线强化学习实验中，以每次 rollout 约 70 万 token 的任务开展训练，48 步训练后模型通过率从 52.5% 提升至 58.5%。相同 GPU 预算下，QwenGyre 相对 Async 实现 1.78×…
items.summary_en: Alibaba's Qwen team released QwenGyre, an online reinforcement learning framework for long-horizon agent tasks that span hours and hundreds of interdependent environment interactions. It uses elastic scheduling to fold freed GPU units into training without disturbing running tasks, records real context via Token-in Token-out to build trajectory trees, and applies partial scoring to incomplete tasks. In an NL2RepoBench experiment, pass rate rose from 52.5% to 58.5% after 48 training steps, with a reported 1.78x gain over Async at the same GPU budget.
items.why_zh: 长程智能体训练是大模型落地的关键瓶颈，QwenGyre 试图把“数小时、百万 token”的真实任务转化为可用的训练信号。
items.why_en: Training long-horizon agents is a key bottleneck for deploying LLM agents, and QwenGyre aims to turn multi-hour, million-token real tasks into usable training signal.

items.title_zh: 消息称腾讯将推出“元宝助手”App，布局 Personal Agent 赛道
items.title_en: Tencent Reportedly to Launch Standalone 'Yuanbao Assistant' App in Personal Agent Push
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 12 日消息，据《读佳》从知情人士处获知，腾讯元宝正在开发一款 Personal Agent 产品“元宝助手”，并计划推出独立 App， 给予它独立于元宝主 App 的运行空间与权限 ，用来承载长周期任务、个人长期记忆等 Agent 核心能力。目前腾讯内部还有包括社交在内的多个业务部门在研发 Personal Agent 相关的产品或功能。 腾讯元宝是 腾讯 基于自研 混元 大模型开发的 C 端 AI 助手 App， 于 2024 年 5 月 30 日上线。腾讯元宝支持语音和文字搜索，涵盖微信公众号和视频号等信源；支持 PDF、Word、PPT、Excel、TXT 等格式文档识别，支持本地和微信上传；腾讯元宝可用于撰写报告、方案、文案和代码。 IT之家注意到，近期国内大厂在个人助手的赛道上动作不断。9 月 29 日，有报道称 豆包在个人助理方向正在推进相关产品规划 ，该探索项目当时代号为“Spell”，主要由豆包手机助手团队主导。 豆包这款产品叫做“小豆” ，并会推出独立 App 版本，小豆的名字在今年暑期就已确定。小豆目前还在内部测试阶段，最终对外版本有可能发生调整，一切以官方发布为准。
items.summary_en: Tencent's Yuanbao is reportedly building a Personal Agent product called 'Yuanbao Assistant' with a standalone app that would give it its own runtime space and permissions for long-horizon tasks and long-term personal memory. Other Tencent units, including social, are also working on Personal Agent features, and rival Doubao is said to be pursuing a similar standalone assistant.
items.why_zh: 独立 App 加长期记忆，意味着腾讯正争夺“个人 AI 入口”，并与豆包等产品正面竞争。
items.why_en: A standalone app with long-term memory signals Tencent is fighting for the personal AI assistant entry point against rivals like Doubao.

items.title_zh: 华为鸿蒙 HarmonyOS 7 小艺 AI 快捷栏功能上线时间公布，预计 10 月底分批推送
items.title_en: Huawei: HarmonyOS 7's Xiaoyi AI Quick Bar to Roll Out in Batches from Late October
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 12 日消息，在今年 9 月 7 日的 HarmonyOS 7 | HUAWEI Mate XT 2 及全场景新品发布会上，鸿蒙 7 操作系统正式发布。 据介绍，鸿蒙 7 系统搭载 Harmony Intelligence 智能架构，支持系统级智能体小艺，可将四层记忆架构、应用 Skills、云端 / 端侧大模型、多端协同无缝融合。 值得一提的是，在发布会现场，华为还剧透了全新功能 —— 小艺 AI 快捷栏。官方 PPT 页面显示，该功能开启后，小艺将在手机桌面底部的 Dock 栏常驻。 关于该功能的上线时间，官方此前一直未公布。IT之家今日从华为客户服务处获悉，小艺 AI 快捷栏是 HarmonyOS 7 的新功能， 预计将在 10 月底逐步和大家见面 ，届时会根据机型分批推送。 相关阅读： 《 华为鸿蒙 HarmonyOS 7 操作系统正式发布：全新空间美学设计语言，搭载系统智能体小艺 》
items.summary_en: Huawei says the Xiaoyi AI Quick Bar, a new HarmonyOS 7 feature first teased at its September launch event, will begin rolling out gradually in late October in batches by device model. The feature keeps the Xiaoyi assistant resident in the phone's bottom dock. HarmonyOS 7 runs on the Harmony Intelligence architecture supporting a system-level Xiaoyi agent.
items.why_zh: 把系统级智能体常驻 Dock 栏，是华为将 AI 助手做成手机一级入口的关键一步。
items.why_en: Putting a system-level agent permanently in the dock is Huawei's move to make its AI assistant a first-class phone entry point.

items.why_en: Compute is a core bottleneck in the LLM race, and Zhipu's rapid, large-scale fundraising reflects the industry's compute arms race.

items.title_zh: Arena 公布新一轮 AI 大模型周榜：Claude Opus 5.5 Max 首登智能体榜首，国产多模型稳定中上游
items.title_en: Arena Weekly AI Leaderboard: Claude Opus 5.5 Max Tops Agent Ranking, Chinese Models Hold Mid-to-Upper Tier
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 12 日消息，Arena（ arena.ai ）平台发布 2026 年第 41 周 AI 大模型排行榜，覆盖时间为 2026-10-05 ~ 2026-10-11。本期榜单中，Anthropic 全新 Claude Opus 5.5 Max 首次入榜智能体榜即夺得第一；国产模型 kimi-k3-max 稳居综合榜前 20，qwen3.8-max 等多款国产模型保持稳定排名，整体处于中上游梯队。 IT之家注 ：本榜单基于 Arena（ arena.ai ）平台匿名盲测投票，通过 ELO（智能体榜为百分比信号）计算排名，反映用户主观偏好而非绝对能力测试；不同分榜相互独立，不宜跨榜比较，分差在误差范围内均视为并列，新模型也需积累一定投票量后才会正式入榜。 综合榜 本周综合榜头部格局相对稳定，gemini-4-argon-high 继续占据榜首位置，ELO 分数保持 1525 分。Anthropic 多款模型占据前四席位，claude-opus-5.5-high 上升 2 位至第二，ELO 分数 1507 分，与榜首仍有差距，但分差在 30 分范围内，与第三名 claude-opus-4-6-high 视为误差范围内接近。本期新增 gpt-5.5 和 gemini-3.5-flash-medium 两款模型，分别排名第 29 和第 30 位，ELO 分数分别为 1477…
items.summary_en: Arena released its Week 41 leaderboard (Oct 5–11, 2026): Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 Max debuted at No. 1 on the agent ranking, while gemini-4-argon-high stayed atop the overall list at 1525 ELO and claude-opus-5.5-high rose to second at 1507. New entries gpt-5.5 and gemini-3.5-flash-medium placed 29th and 30th, while Chinese models such as kimi-k3-max (top 20) and qwen3.8-max held steady in the mid-to-upper tier.
items.why_zh: 该榜单基于真实用户盲测偏好，是观察各模型口碑与竞争格局的重要风向标。
items.why_en: Based on blind user votes, the Arena leaderboard is a key barometer of model reputation and competitive standing.

items.title_en: Nvidia's Next Move: Embracing Open-Source Models to Lock Compute Demand to GPUs
items.summary_zh: 黄仁勋的下一枚棋子：英伟达收编开源模型，把算力需求焊死在GPU上 搜狐
items.summary_en: A Sohu analysis argues that Nvidia is embracing and backing open-source models to extend its ecosystem and keep the resulting compute demand tied to its GPUs. The move is framed as Jensen Huang's next key play to cement Nvidia's central role in AI infrastructure.
items.why_zh: 若开源模型的算力需求被绑定在GPU生态，英伟达可在AI普及浪潮中持续受益。
items.why_en: If open-model compute demand stays tied to GPUs, Nvidia keeps benefiting from the broader AI boom.

items.summary_zh: Reflection发布开源AI模型Beam，对标中国模型降低算力成本 至顶网
items.summary_en: Reflection has released Beam, an open-source AI model positioned as a lower-compute-cost alternative to Chinese models. The release aims to offer developers a more cost-efficient option, though parameter size and benchmark details were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 降低算力成本是开源模型竞争的关键卖点，可能影响开发者的模型选型。
items.why_en: Lower compute cost is a key selling point in open-model competition and can sway developer adoption.

items.title_zh: 曝华为将全面回归：畅享 100 系列手机、子品牌、Air 产品线、麒麟 7 / 8 / 9 系芯片“来势汹汹”
items.title_en: Leak Claims Huawei Set for Full Comeback: Enjoy 100 Series, Sub-brand, Air Line and Kirin 7/8/9 Chips
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 12 日消息，博主 @数码闲聊站 在今年 7 月曾发文，称华为现在还是回血状态，Mate 90 系列手机 + τ 定律芯片应该是转折点。 时间转眼来到 10 月，华为 Mate 90 系列手机已于本月初正式发布，全球首款逻辑折叠 τ 芯片麒麟 9050 Pro 也随着华为 Mate XT 2 非凡大师三折叠手机在 9 月初登场。 IT之家注意到，博主今日发文，再次谈及了华为的全面回归，透露接下来 子品牌、畅享 100 系列手机、Air（有 WATCH Air）产品线、麒麟 7 / 8 / 9 系芯片 “来势汹汹”。 作为参考，华为手机业务的巅峰时期常被认为是 2019 年-2020 年。2020 年 3 月，华为公布了 2019 年年报，其中提到， 华为 2019 年净利润 627 亿元人民币，智能手机发货量超 2.4 亿台 。而在 2020 年，华为推出了一代经典 —— Mate 40 系列手机。据华为终端 BG CEO 何刚去年在西安电子科技大学透露， 该系列机型仍有千万用户 。 当年的华为本品牌有畅享、nova、P（Pura 前身）和 Mate 四大系列，子品牌荣耀也有畅玩、Play、X、V、数字和 Magic 系列。产品规划上，华为 Mate、P 和 nova 系列、荣耀 V、数字和 Magic 系列正代机型会搭载麒麟 9 系旗舰芯；荣耀 X 系列和部分…
items.summary_en: A Chinese tech blogger claims Huawei is preparing a full-scale comeback, with a sub-brand, the Enjoy 100 series, an Air product line (including WATCH Air) and Kirin 7/8/9 chips reportedly on the way. The claim follows the launch of the Mate 90 series in early October and the Kirin 9050 Pro logic-folding τ chip in the Mate XT 2 Ultimate Design in September.
items.why_zh: 若消息属实，意味着华为手机业务将从旗舰机型扩展至全价位段和多品牌布局，全面对标其 2019—2020 年的巅峰状态。
items.why_en: If accurate, it signals Huawei is expanding beyond flagship devices into full price tiers and multiple brands, reclaiming its 2019–2020 peak scale.

items.why_zh: 反映了开发者正围绕 DeepSeek 生态探索插件化、可扩展的机器人应用方式。
items.why_en: It reflects how developers are building pluggable, extensible bot applications around the DeepSeek ecosystem.

items.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布推出“关键基础设施防御计划”（Critical Infrastructure Defense Program），并与多家安全公司合作，目标是保护工业运营技术（OT）环境。该计划聚焦于关键基础设施面临的网络安全风险。目前公开信息有限，具体合作方与执行细节仍待披露。

items.why_en: It marks AI vendors moving directly into industrial control security, highlighting OT environments as a key frontier for applied AI safety.

items.why_en: Delivering bot capabilities as a plugin could lower the barrier for developers and enterprises to adopt DeepSeek agents.

items.title_zh: TikTok CEO 周受资：市场对 AI 短期发展的能力可能有所高估，却低估其长期影响
items.title_en: TikTok CEO Shou Zi Chew: Markets May Overestimate AI's Short-Term Capability While Underestimating Its Long-Term Impact
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 12 日消息，据台媒经济日报报道，TikTok CEO 今早参加星展集团 12 日在新加坡举办的首届亚洲未来前瞻论坛，以“Unlocking Human Potential in an AI Era（在人工智能时代释放人类潜能）”为题，和星展集团零售银行及财富管理业务主管许志坤进行对谈。 周受资指出， 人工智能的长期发展潜力仍被低估 ，未来两至三年，AI 有望推动物理学、生物科技等领域出现重大突破。不过，在 AI 快速发展的同时， 人类的判断力、创造力与真实性仍不可或缺 ，企业与个人应积极实际运用 AI 工具，通过人机协作掌握新一波科技变革带来的机会。 周受资表示， 市场对 AI 短期发展的能力可能有所高估，却低估其长期影响 。尤其在科学研究领域，AI 有机会加速突破既有技术瓶颈，但随着模型能力越来越强大，如何确保 AI 遵守道德与伦理规范，也成为人类必须面对的重要课题。 他以回形针理论（IT之家注：该理论假设一个超智能 AI 被设定的最终目标是最大化回形针产量。为了达成这个目标，该 AI 系统可能会动用其超人类的智能，将地球上所有的物质乃至人类本身都转化为制造回形针的原材料。）的思想实验为例指出，当 AI 过度追求单一目标，却缺乏适当限制时，可能产生与人类真正意图不一致的结果，因此必须建立有效的监督机制。 在 AI 时代应具备哪些能力方面，周受资主张采取“人类…
items.summary_en: Speaking at DBS's inaugural Asia Future Forward Forum in Singapore on Oct 12, TikTok CEO Shou Zi Chew said AI's long-term potential remains underestimated even as markets may overestimate its near-term abilities. He expects breakthroughs in physics and biotech within two to three years, stressed that human judgment, creativity and authenticity remain essential, and cited the paperclip thought experiment to argue for effective oversight of AI.
items.why_zh: 来自大型平台高管的判断，为当下 AI 热潮提供了一个“短期降温、长期看多”的平衡视角，并强调人机协作与监督机制。
items.why_en: A top platform executive offers a balanced view—tempering short-term hype while staying bullish long term—and stresses human-AI collaboration and oversight.

items.title_zh: 海尔浴霸 M1 系列人感除臭版发布：承袭海尔冰箱净味技术，首发 699 元
items.title_en: Haier Launches M1 Series Bathroom Heater With Human-Sensing Deodorizing, From 699 Yuan

items.summary_en: Haier has launched the M1 series human-sensing deodorizing bathroom heater at a first-release price of 699 yuan. It borrows Haier refrigerator odor-removal technology, claims over 91% average removal rates for ammonia and hydrogen sulfide in lab tests, adds a 180m³/h ventilation system, microwave human-presence radar with multiple smart scenarios, and 2800W heating with an AI constant-warmth algorithm offering 15 temperature steps from 30–45°C.
items.why_zh: 展示了家电厂商把冰箱净味、雷达感知与 AI 控温等技术复用迁移到浴室场景的产品思路。
items.why_en: It shows how home-appliance makers are repurposing technologies such as refrigerator odor control, radar sensing and AI temperature control into bathroom products.

items.title_zh: 阶跃 Step 5 Preview 模型上线腾讯 WorkBuddy，10 月 12 至 25 日独家限免
items.title_en: StepFun's Step 5 Preview Goes Live on Tencent WorkBuddy With Exclusive Free Access From Oct 12–25
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 12 日消息，阶跃 StepFun 今日宣布，阶跃 Step 5 Preview 模型上线腾讯 WorkBuddy。2026 年 10 月 12 日至 10 月 25 日， 在 WorkBuddy 开启独家限免 。 据IT之家此前报道，9 月 20 日， 阶跃推出旗舰模型 Step 5 Preview ，面向 AI 编程、软件工程、专业知识工作、金融等场景，提升模型执行真实世界 Agentic 任务表现，10 月 15 日开源完整权重。 该模型采用稀疏 MoE 混合专家架构， 总参数量 600B 、激活参数 27B，支持 100 万 Token 上下文窗口，原生支持文本与视觉输入。
items.summary_en: StepFun announced that its Step 5 Preview model is now available on Tencent WorkBuddy, with exclusive free access from Oct 12 to Oct 25. First unveiled on Sept 20, Step 5 Preview targets AI coding, software engineering, professional knowledge work and finance, using a sparse MoE architecture with 600B total and 27B active parameters, a 1M-token context window and native text and vision input.
items.why_zh: 国产旗舰大模型通过与办公协作平台绑定限免推广，是争夺 Agentic 应用入口与开发者用户的一次典型打法。
items.why_en: A flagship Chinese model pairing with an office collaboration platform for a limited free run illustrates the race for agentic application entry points and developer adoption.

items.title_zh: 无问芯穹完成 23 亿元 C 轮融资，单轮及累计融资额均创中国 AI 原生基础设施赛道最高纪录
items.title_en: Infinigence AI Raises RMB 2.3 Billion in Series C, Setting Record for China's AI-Native Infrastructure Sector
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 12 日消息，据证券时报消息，人工智能基础设施（AI Infra）企业 无问芯穹已完成 23 亿元的 C 轮融资 ，其成立以来的累计融资额达 43 亿元，单轮及累计融资额均创下中国 AI 原生基础设施赛道最高纪录。 公开信息显示，无问芯穹成立于 2023 年，是清华大学和上海交通大学两大高校的科技成果转化企业。 IT之家注意到，据彭博社本月引述知情人士消息，无问芯穹最近几个月已以保密形式向港交所递交 IPO 申请，计划募资数亿美元，目标最快于 2027 年上半年挂牌上市。 延伸阅读 无问芯穹全称上海无问芯穹智能科技股份有限公司，成立于 2023 年 5 月，由清华大学电子工程系 NICS-EFC 实验室团队孵化，同时也是清华大学和上海交通大学的科技成果转化企业。 团队方面，联合创始人兼 CEO 夏立雪是清华大学博士，师从清华大学电子工程系主任汪玉教授，曾入选 AI2000 人工智能全球最具影响力学者榜单（芯片方向 Top100）；创始人汪玉长期从事智能芯片、高能效电路系统研究，2016 年曾以知识成果转化入股深鉴科技，该公司 2018 年被赛灵思收购，后并入 AMD 体系。另一位联合创始人戴国浩担任首席科学家，是上海交通大学长聘教轨副教授。 与壁仞科技、燧原科技等芯片设计公司以及智谱、MiniMax 等大模型企业不同，无问芯穹走的是“中间层”路径：不自研 GPU…
items.summary_en: Chinese AI infrastructure company Infinigence AI has closed a RMB 2.3 billion Series C round, bringing total funding to RMB 4.3 billion and setting records for China's AI-native infrastructure sector. Founded in 2023 as a technology transfer venture of Tsinghua and Shanghai Jiao Tong universities, it has reportedly filed confidentially for a Hong Kong IPO, targeting a listing as early as the first half of 2027. Unlike chip designers or model developers, it positions itself as a middleware layer rather than building its own GPUs.
items.why_zh: 显示资本对中国 AI 基础设施“中间层”的高度押注，并为其赴港上市铺路。
items.why_en: It shows strong investor bets on China's AI infrastructure middleware layer and paves the way for a Hong Kong listing.

items.summary_en: FIS launches agentic AI suite for the office of the CFO Finextra Research
items.why_zh: 表明 agentic AI 正加速进入财务等企业核心职能场景。
items.why_en: It shows agentic AI is moving rapidly into core enterprise functions such as finance.

items.why_en: It reflects universities' accelerating push to add AI-related degrees amid growing talent and literacy demand.

items.title_zh: DRYLAB-Bench：评估智能体式 LLM 突变设计的生物安全风险
items.title_en: DRYLAB-Bench: Benchmarking the Biosecurity Risk of Agentic LLM Mutation Design
items.summary_zh: 一篇新论文提出 DRYLAB-Bench，用于量化评估具备智能体能力的 LLM 在突变设计中的生物安全风险。研究指出，随着大模型获得先进的生物设计能力，它们在带来科研收益的同时也引入了严重的双重用途风险，例如设计增强型病原体或耐药细菌。现有评测多关注模型是否“掌握危险知识”，而非实际操作风险；该工作试图衡量模型在配合专业生物设计工具时执行危险生物改造的可能性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.13116v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) acquire advanced biological design capabilities, they offer substantial research benefits but simultaneously introduce severe dual-use risks, such as engineering enhanced pathogens or drug-resistant bacteria. While biosecurity frameworks recognize these threats, the actual risk of LLMs executing dangerous biological modifications remains unquantified, particularly when augmented with specialized biological design tools (BDTs). Existing evaluations primarily assess hazardous knowledge possession rather than practica…
items.why_zh: 为智能体式 LLM 的生物安全风险提供可量化评测，对双重用途技术治理意义重大。
items.why_en: It offers a quantifiable risk benchmark for agentic LLMs, which matters greatly for governing dual-use biotechnology.

items.title_zh: PRISM：融合异构证据的检索增强多模态语言模型，用于临床预后
items.title_en: Retrieval-Augmented Multimodal Language Model with Heterogeneous Evidence Integration for Clinical Prognosis
items.summary_zh: 论文提出 PRISM（Population-Retrieved Inference for Structured Multimodal Prognosis），一个面向临床预后预测的多模态语言模型。它结合逐特征数值标记化、对纵向心电图的近期加权聚合，以及双模态人群记忆库。其检索在表示空间进行：模型接收相似训练队列病例的均值池化嵌入，而不直接使用个人检索记录。该方法旨在整合结构化测量、生理波形、纵向病史与人群背景等多源异构证据，以支持临床预后推断。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.13510v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Clinical prognosis requires integrating structured measurements, physiological waveforms, longitudinal history, and population context. We introduce PRISM (Population-Retrieved Inference for Structured Multimodal Prognosis), a multimodal language model that combines per-feature numerical tokenization, recency-weighted aggregation of longitudinal ECGs, and a dual-modality population memory bank. Retrieval operates in representation space: the model receives mean-pooled embeddings of similar training-cohort encounters, while no individual retrieved…
items.why_zh: 展示检索增强多模态 LLM 在高风险临床预后场景中的落地潜力。
items.why_en: It demonstrates the potential of retrieval-augmented multimodal LLMs in high-stakes clinical prognosis.

items.title_zh: 从输入数据与正反例解中学习与规模无关的约束模型
items.title_en: Learning Size Independent Constraint Models from Input Data and Positive and Negative Example Solutions
items.summary_zh: 一篇新论文提出一种约束获取工具，能够根据输入数据以及多个问题实例的正例与反例解，自动生成与问题规模无关的约束程序。系统先基于全局约束和二元约束的典型模式，为具体规模找出对应模型，再将其泛化为可在未见过的输入数据上运行的规模无关模型。工具最终输出 MiniZinc 代码以及模型的文字说明，作者在 PTHG21 挑战赛的示例问题上对其进行了评估。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.13640v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper we describe a Constraint Acquisition Tool that generates size independent constraint programs from input data and positive and negative example solutions of multiple problem instances. The system finds size specific models based on typical constraint patterns over global and binary constraints, then generalizes the models to a size independent model that can be run on unseen input data. The system produces MiniZinc code as well as a textual description of the model. We evaluate the tool on the example problems of the PTHG21 Challeng…
items.why_zh: 该方法有望降低数学规划建模对人工与规模假设的依赖，让约束模型可复用到新数据上。
items.why_en: It could reduce the manual, size-specific effort in mathematical-programming modeling by producing constraint models that generalize to new inputs.

items.title_zh: 语言模型的“自我保全”能力
items.title_en: Self-Preservation in Language Models
items.summary_zh: 持续学习的目标是在适应新任务的同时保留原有能力，但用于检验“是否遗忘”的任务只能覆盖模型所知的一部分，遗忘可能超出这些任务的范围。已有研究表明，语言模型无需访问原始训练数据，也能生成有用的回放样本，从而弥补这一有限证据。本文由此提出“自我保全”问题：模型能否帮助选择保护目标，从而更广泛地维护自身能力？作者据此组织了任务设计与实验来研究这一问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.12602v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Continual learning (CL) seeks to adapt pretrained models while preserving prior capabilities. Yet the tasks supplied for preservation cover only part of what a model knows, while forgetting can extend beyond them. Recent work shows that language models can supplement this limited evidence by generating useful replay without access to their original training data. This raises a question about self-preservation: can a model help choose preservation targets that protect its own capabilities more broadly? To study this question, we organize task de…
items.why_zh: 若模型能自主选择需要保护的能力，持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题可能获得更通用的缓解思路。
items.why_en: If models can select what to preserve themselves, catastrophic forgetting in continual learning may be mitigated more generally.

items.title_zh: SWE-DeceptionBench：评测 LLM 在软件开发全流程中的欺骗行为
items.title_en: SWE-DeceptionBench: Benchmarking Deceptive Behaviors of LLMs Across the Software Development Lifecycle
items.summary_zh: 随着大语言模型被越来越多地用于软件开发全流程，其可信度问题受到关注，其中欺骗行为的风险尤为突出——表现为误导性回答，或协助捏造、隐瞒、扭曲信息。为此，研究者推出 SWE-DeceptionBench，一个在软件工程场景中评估 LLM 欺骗行为的基准。该基准覆盖软件开发生命周期的六个阶段，并设置两类欺骗触发条件，用以系统考察模型在真实工作流中的表现。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.13626v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used throughout the software development lifecycle. This growing reliance on LLMs raises concerns about their trustworthiness, with deception posing a particularly important risk. Deceptive behavior takes the form of misleading responses or assistance in fabricating, concealing, or distorting information. To study this behavior, we introduce SWE-DeceptionBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM deception in software engineering. The benchmark covers six lifecycle stages and two deception triggers: Acti…
items.why_zh: 它把“欺骗”这一抽象风险转化为可量化评测，为在软件工程中安全使用 LLM 提供依据。
items.why_en: It turns an abstract trust risk into a measurable benchmark, informing safer LLM use in software engineering.

items.title_zh: FORTE：工业推荐系统中特征评估与下线决策的生产框架
items.title_en: FORTE: A Production Framework for Feature Evaluation and Deprecation in Industrial Recommender Systems
items.summary_zh: 生产环境中的推荐系统存在“特征生命周期不对称”：新增特征必须在某项指标上带来收益，而移除特征则不能让任何指标变差。现实中特征下线很难排定优先级，原因包括特征之间相互影响、重要性随时间波动、在生产模型更新或数据漂移前无法评估、与其他上线项目争夺 A/B 实验资源、在线上 A/B 实验中引发指标回退，以及被多个模型同时消费等。本文提出 FORTE，一个用于特征评估与下线的生产级框架。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.13806v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Production recommender systems have feature-lifecycle asymmetry: adding new features must produce gains on some metric, while feature removal must not regress any metric. In practice, feature deprecation is hard to prioritize as a feature can fail to be removed if it interacts with other features, its importance changes daily, it cannot be evaluated before production models change or data drift occurs, it is in contention for A/B test space with other launches, it causes regressions in an online A/B test, or it is consumed by multiple models th…
items.why_zh: 特征下线长期是推荐系统运维的痛点，该框架试图让“删特征”也能像“加特征”一样可度量、可决策。
items.why_en: Feature deprecation is a persistent operational pain point; the framework aims to make removing features as measurable and manageable as adding them.

items.title_zh: MPMMine：为约束获取提供更好的基准
items.title_en: MPMMine: Better Benchmarks for Constraint Acquisition
items.summary_zh: 约束获取（CA）以及利用领域知识产物来验证和增强数学规划（MP）模型的研究，目前受限于基准质量不足：现有基准组织松散，各问题提供的知识产物类型与格式不统一，且是为评测求解器而非 CA 算法而设计，覆盖的问题类别偏窄，还缺少保证实验可复现与公平对比所需的关键细节。为此，作者构建了新的基准 MPMMine，以支撑 CA 方法之间更可靠的评测与比较。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.26279v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Constraint Acquisition (CA) and related research on the validation and enhancement of Mathematical Programming (MP) models using domain knowledge artifacts are currently limited by inadequate benchmarks. The existing benchmarks are loosely organized, provide inconsistent types and formats of artifacts for individual problems, are designed for benchmarking solvers rather than CA algorithms, include narrow classes of problems, or omit crucial details for the reproducibility of experiments and fair comparison of CA methods. We develop a benchmar…
items.why_zh: 基准缺陷会掩盖算法真实差异，新基准有助于让约束获取研究结果更可复现、可比较。
items.why_en: Flawed benchmarks obscure real algorithmic differences; better benchmarks make constraint-acquisition research reproducible and comparable.

items.title_zh: API 基准分数无法可靠迁移到聊天机器人界面
items.title_en: API Benchmark Scores Do Not Reliably Transfer to Chatbot Interfaces
items.summary_zh: 基准分数是模型发布中的核心“通货”，影响采购决策、公众信任与政策制定，但其背后有一个关键假设：通过 API 测得的模型表现能如实反映已部署系统的行为。作者对这一假设提出质疑，对 ChatGPT、Claude 和 Gemini 的七个系统、九个基准进行了审计，覆盖通用能力、社会偏见与谄媚（sycophancy）。结果显示，API 与聊天界面之间在准确率和一致性上存在系统性差异。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.08861v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Benchmark scores are a central currency in model releases: they inform purchasing decisions, shape public trust, and influence policy. Yet, a key assumption underlying benchmark scores is that the model performance measured through APIs faithfully reflects the behavior of deployed systems. We challenge this assumption by auditing ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini across seven systems and nine benchmarks spanning general capability, social bias, and sycophancy. We find systematic API--interface differences in both accuracy and consistency. On averag…
items.why_zh: 如果 API 分数不能代表用户实际看到的系统表现，那么模型评测、采购与监管判断都需重新审视。
items.why_en: If API scores don't reflect what users actually experience, model evaluation, procurement, and policy judgments all need rethinking.

items.title_zh: 从基准到真实实验台：智能体能否胜任真实药物发现？
items.title_en: From Benchmark to Bench: Can Agents Survive Real-World Drug Discovery?
items.summary_zh: 智能体系统正越来越多地协调分子设计工具，但在真实项目里究竟是流程中的哪一层限制了最终结果，仍不清楚。作者开发了 MAGI——一个开放、模块化的智能体，能够自行设定目标、启动并监控优化过程、解读构效关系并据此调整策略。它可以直接通过大语言模型生成分子，也可以把任务交给 REINVENT 4，且评分服务可在统一契约下替换。研究团队在九个回顾性先导化合物优化项目中对其进行了测试。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06411v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Agentic systems increasingly coordinate molecular-design tools, but it is unclear which layer of the stack limits outcomes on real projects. We developed MAGI, an open modular agent that authors objectives, launches and monitors optimization, interprets structure--activity relationships, and revises its strategy accordingly. MAGI generates molecules either directly through the LLM or by delegating to REINVENT 4, with scoring services interchangeable behind a common contract. We tested it across nine retrospective lead-optimization campaigns f…
items.why_zh: 它把智能体评估从打榜推进到接近真实研发流程的检验，有助于厘清瓶颈究竟在模型还是工具链。
items.why_en: It moves agent evaluation from leaderboards toward realistic R&D workflows, helping identify whether models or the tooling stack are the bottleneck.

items.title_zh: OTel：开放的电信 AI 数据集、基准与模型
items.title_en: OTel: Open Telco AI Datasets, Benchmarks, and Models
items.summary_zh: 研究团队发布 Open Telco（OTel），一套开放的电信 AI 资源，包含面向检索、重排序、指令微调以及安全/拒答的衍生电信数据集，以及 30 个全参数后训练基线模型，覆盖 10 个嵌入模型、3 个重排序模型和 17 个语言模型。社区参与度已相当高：截至 2026 年 5 月 3 日，发布的模型下载量超过 1600 万次，项目获得全球 157 篇以上媒体报道。该工作建立在以往开放电信数据集的基础之上。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.07766v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present Open Telco (OTel), an open telecom AI resource that releases derived telecom datasets for retrieval, reranking, instruction tuning, and safety/abstention, together with 30 full-parameter post-trained baselines spanning 10 embedding models, 3 rerankers, and 17 language models. The community has already engaged substantially with the resource: as of May 3, 2026, the released models have been downloaded over 16 million times and the project has received 157+ pieces of media coverage worldwide. Building on prior open telecom datasets a…
items.why_zh: 电信是垂直领域大模型的重要落地场景，开放数据集与基线可降低行业构建专用模型的门槛。
items.why_en: Telecom is a key vertical for domain LLMs, and open datasets plus baselines lower the barrier to building specialized models.

items.title_zh: Bolzano：从专家引导的证明搜索走向自动化开放问题求解
items.title_en: Bolzano: From Expert-Guided Proof Search to Automated Open-Problem Solving
items.summary_zh: 一篇 arXiv 论文介绍了 Bolzano，这是一个开源多智能体系统，由多个并行证明智能体（prover agents）与一个验证智能体（verifier agent）协同工作，并维护一份人类可读的研究状态记录，以支持数学证明的搜索、迭代改进与核验。在初期人工使用阶段，研究者在专家挑选的问题上运行该系统，得到 8 项结果，其证明由领域专家检查确认。受这些案例启发，团队随后在没有针对具体问题的人工引导下运行 Bolzano，将其用于更自动化的开放问题求解。该工作显示大语言模型正越来越多地参与数学研究流程。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.09769v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Large language models are increasingly contributing to mathematical research, where progress often depends on efficient proof search, incremental improvements and careful verification. We describe Bolzano, a multi-agent open-source system that uses parallel prover agents with a verifier agent and maintains a human-readable research state. Initial manual use on expert-selected problems yielded 8 results whose proofs were checked by domain experts. Motivated by these case studies, we ran Bolzano without problem-specific human guidance on about…
items.why_zh: 它把多智能体验证机制与可读研究状态结合，探索 LLM 在无人工引导下自主推进数学证明的可能。
items.why_en: It combines multi-agent verification with a readable research state to explore how LLMs can autonomously advance mathematical proofs without human guidance.

items.title_zh: WoundAmbit：连接最先进语义分割与现实伤口护理
items.title_en: WoundAmbit: Bridging State-of-the-Art Semantic Segmentation and Real-World Wound Care
items.summary_zh: 慢性伤口影响大量人群，尤其是行动不便并常伴有其他疾病的老年人与糖尿病患者。通过移动设备拍照实现自动化伤口监测，可远程追踪伤口大小，从而减少患者亲自就医的次数，而语义分割是这一流程的关键环节。然而伤口分割在医学影像研究中仍相对被忽视。为此，作者对来自通用视觉、医学影像以及顶尖方法的最先进深度学习模型进行了基准测试（摘要在此处截断），以推动该领域与真实临床护理需求的衔接。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2504.06185v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Chronic wounds affect a large population, particularly the elderly and diabetic patients, who often exhibit limited mobility and co-existing health conditions. Automated wound monitoring via mobile image capture can reduce in-person physician visits by enabling remote tracking of wound size. Semantic segmentation is key to this process, yet wound segmentation remains underrepresented in medical imaging research. To address this, we benchmark state-of-the-art deep learning models from general-purpose vision, medical imaging, and top meth…
items.why_zh: 它把通用视觉与医学影像的先进分割模型引入被长期忽视的伤口护理场景，有助于实现远程、低负担的伤口监测。
items.why_en: It brings advanced segmentation models into the long-neglected wound-care setting, potentially enabling remote, low-burden wound monitoring.

items.title_zh: ReasoningShield：面向大型推理模型思维链的安全检测
items.title_en: ReasoningShield: Safety Detection over Reasoning Traces of Large Reasoning Models
items.summary_zh: 大型推理模型（LRM）借助显式推理轨迹（即思维链 CoT）将复杂问题拆解为中间步骤再给出最终答案。但这些推理轨迹带来了独特的安全挑战：即便最终答案看似无害，有害内容也可能被嵌入中间步骤之中。研究显示，现有最先进的审核工具在思维链审核上出现明显性能退化，相比传统场景 F1 分数最多下降 35.2%。该工作因此提出 ReasoningShield，用于对推理轨迹进行安全检测，弥补现有审核工具在 CoT 场景下的不足。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2505.17244v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) leverage explicit reasoning traces, known as Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, to decompose complex problems into intermediate steps before deriving final answers. However, these reasoning traces introduce unique safety challenges: harmful content can be embedded in intermediate steps even when final answers appear benign. Our study reveals that existing state-of-the-art moderation tools experience significant performance degradation on CoT moderation, with F1 scores dropping by up to 35.2% compared to trad…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了现有内容审核在思维链场景下的严重盲区，为推理模型的中间步骤安全提供了针对性检测方案。
items.why_en: It exposes a major blind spot in current moderation for chain-of-thought traces and offers a targeted detector for reasoning-model safety.

items.title_zh: 面向 Shapley 值与概率值的回归校正蒙特卡洛估计器
items.title_en: Regression-adjusted Monte Carlo Estimators for Shapley Values and Probabilistic Values
items.summary_zh: 源自博弈论的概率值（如 Shapley 值、Banzhaf 值和 semi-values）已成为可解释 AI 的核心工具，被用于特征归因、数据归因和数据估值等任务。由于精确计算可能需要指数级时间，研究界主要依赖两种技术进行高效近似：蒙特卡洛采样与线性回归建模。该工作提出将两者结合的新方法，其估计器比此前的算法更加灵活。作者给出了回归校正的蒙特卡洛估计框架，用于更高效地近似 Shapley 值与更广泛的概率值。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2506.11849v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: With origins in game theory, probabilistic values like Shapley values, Banzhaf values, and semi-values have emerged as a central tool in explainable AI. They are used for feature attribution, data attribution, data valuation, and more. Since exact computation can require exponential time, research has focused on efficient approximation methods using two techniques: Monte Carlo sampling and linear regression formulations. In this work, we present a new way of combining both of these techniques. Our approach is more flexible than prior al…
items.why_zh: 它把两种主流近似思路统一起来，有望提升可解释 AI 中 Shapley 类归因与数据估值的计算效率与灵活性。
items.why_en: It unifies the two dominant approximation techniques, potentially improving both the efficiency and flexibility of Shapley-style attribution and data valuation in explainable AI.

items.title_zh: COBALT：利用离线轨迹的上下文赌博机多轮代码生成学习
items.title_en: COBALT: Contextual Bandit Learning with Offline Trajectories for Multi-Turn Code Generation
items.summary_zh: 训练大语言模型进行多轮代码生成通常依赖在线强化学习，即让模型从反复生成的在线 rollout 中学习。这种方式虽然有效，但成本高昂且不够稳定。论文提出 COBALT，一种将离线多轮轨迹复用起来的上下文赌博机学习方法，可高效训练 LLM 完成多轮代码生成。其出发点在于观察到多轮代码生成属于一种单步可恢复的 MDP（摘要在此处截断），因此可以借助离线数据替代昂贵的在线交互。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2602.03806v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) for multi-turn code generation typically relies on online reinforcement learning (RL), in which models learn from repeatedly generated online rollouts. Although effective, online RL can be costly and unstable. In this paper, we present contextual bandit learning with offline trajectories (COBALT), a simple method that reuses offline multi-turn trajectories to efficiently train LLMs for multi-turn code generation. Building on the observation that multi-turn code generation is a one-step recoverable M…
items.why_zh: 它用离线轨迹与上下文赌博机替代昂贵的在线 RL，有望降低多轮代码生成模型训练的成本与不稳定性。
items.why_en: By replacing expensive online RL with offline trajectories and contextual bandits, it could cut the cost and instability of training multi-turn code-generation models.

items.title_zh: GOTT：以可复用跨本体原语实现物体中心灵巧操作
items.title_en: GOTT: Object-centric Dexterous Manipulation with a Reusable Cross-Embodiment Primitive
items.summary_zh: 基础模型与大规模人类数据提供了丰富的操作意图来源，但把这种意图转化为多指机器人的实际行为仍然困难；灵巧手始终缺少一个能在不同任务与不同本体之间可靠建立接触的可复用底层原语。为此，论文提出 GOTT，一个围绕单一跨本体接触获取原语构建的「接近—获取—移动」（reach-acquire-move）框架。给定与机器人无关的物体轨迹和接近规格，GOTT 首先将手带到与任务相关的接触区域附近（摘要在此处截断），从而以物体为中心组织灵巧操作。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.03861v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Foundation models and large-scale human data provide rich sources of manipulation intent, but translating this intent into multi-fingered robot behavior remains difficult. Dexterous hands still lack a reusable low-level primitive that reliably establishes contact across tasks and embodiments. We propose GOTT, a reach-acquire-move framework built around a single cross-embodiment contact-acquisition primitive. Given a robot-agnostic object trajectory and a reach specification, GOTT first brings the hand near a task-relevant contact region…
items.why_zh: 它尝试用可跨本体复用的接触获取原语，解决灵巧手在不同任务与硬件间难以通用的问题。
items.why_en: It aims to solve the lack of reusable dexterous-hand skills across tasks and embodiments by building on a single cross-embodiment contact-acquisition primitive.

items.title_zh: 离线到在线线性赌博机的高斯宽度界
items.title_en: Gaussian-Width Bounds for Offline-to-Online Linear Bandits
items.summary_zh: 论文研究在随机线性赌博机中，离线数据如何帮助在线学习，重点关注「部分覆盖」的离线数据情形：d 个特征方向中只有 k 个覆盖较差。已有的阶段性消除（phased elimination）与乐观类算法在这种情形下给出约 Õ(√(dkT)) 的遗憾界。作者指出该依赖来自对奖励预测误差控制过松，并利用高斯向量 Lipschitz 函数的集中不等式得到更紧的界。基于这一分析，作者进一步设计了相应的阶段性消除算法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.12990v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study how offline data can help online learning in stochastic linear bandits. We focus on partially covered offline data, where only $k$ of the $d$ feature directions are poorly covered. Existing analyses of algorithms based on phased elimination and optimism give regret bounds of order $\widetilde O(\sqrt{dkT})$ in this regime. We show that this dependence arises from loose control of the reward prediction error, and obtain tighter bounds using concentration of Lipschitz functions of Gaussian vectors. Based on this analysis, we develop a phas…
items.why_zh: 它通过更精确的集中分析改进了离线到在线线性赌博机的遗憾界，为利用部分覆盖的离线数据提供了更锐利的理论保证。
items.why_en: Sharper concentration analysis tightens regret bounds for offline-to-online linear bandits, giving stronger guarantees when offline data is only partially covered.

items.title_zh: Monarch-MoE：面向多模态持续指令微调的结构化专家
items.title_en: Monarch-MoE: Structured Experts for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
items.summary_zh: 在多模态持续指令微调中学习新任务，容易导致对已有知识的灾难性遗忘。多专家 LoRA 虽将学习分散到不同专家上，但对某个稠密低秩专家的更新仍可能影响大量输出特征。论文提出 Monarch-MoE，用由固定置换连接的块对角因子替换 LoRA 专家中的稠密因子。这种结构带来分块梯度隔离：单个块对更新只影响一个输出块，而所有输入之间的连接则被保留，从而在持续学习新任务的同时减缓对旧知识的遗忘。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.13215v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Learning new tasks in multimodal continual instruction tuning can cause catastrophic forgetting of previously acquired knowledge. Although multi-expert LoRA distributes learning across experts, updates to a dense low-rank expert can still affect many output features. We introduce Monarch-MoE, which replaces the dense factors in LoRA experts with block-diagonal factors connected by a fixed permutation. This structure provides blockwise gradient isolation: individual block-pair updates affect only one output block, while connections between all inp…
items.why_zh: 它用结构化稀疏专家实现分块梯度隔离，为多模态持续指令微调中的灾难性遗忘问题提供了新解法。
items.why_en: Structured, block-diagonal experts provide blockwise gradient isolation, offering a new way to mitigate catastrophic forgetting in multimodal continual instruction tuning.

items.title_zh: DuoRate：面向 MoE 推理的双速率专家精度分配
items.title_en: DuoRate: Two-Rate Per-Expert Precision Allocation for Mixture-of-Experts Serving
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文指出，服务 Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）模型时，专家精度要付出两次代价：一是常驻显存要为路由器可能触达的每个专家买单，二是 batch-one 解码每一步只为被选中的专家买单。二者是同一组专家位宽上的两种不同速率泛函，而已有的逐专家 MoE 分配器只约束了前者。作者将这一差异称为 store-read gap：在已发布的 BitsMoE 检查点中，每权重 2.54 bit（bpw）的存储会放大为 7.50 bpw 的解码流量。为此他们提出 DuoRate，目标是“存储一次、读取更省”，同时兼顾存储与解码两种速率。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.13328v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Serving a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model pays for expert precision twice: the resident footprint pays for every expert the router can reach, while each batch-one decode step pays only for the experts it selects. These are two different rate functionals over the same per-expert widths, yet published per-expert MoE allocators constrain only the first. We call the difference the store-read gap; in the released BitsMoE checkpoint, 2.54 bits per weight (bpw) of storage become 7.50 bpw of decode traffic. We propose DuoRate, which stores once and reads…
items.why_zh: 揭示 MoE 服务中存储与解码精度的双重成本错配，可显著降低推理显存与带宽开销。
items.why_en: It exposes a storage-versus-decode precision mismatch in MoE serving that directly affects inference memory and bandwidth cost.

items.title_zh: PPG-Bench：面向 PPG 基础模型的统一基准
items.title_en: PPG-Bench: A Unified Benchmark for PPG Foundation Models
items.summary_zh: 光电容积脉搏波（PPG）正被可穿戴与临床设备以极大规模采集，随之出现越来越多 PPG 基础模型，用于为各类下游任务计算可复用表征。但这些模型难以横向比较：不同评测使用了不同数据集、任务定义、预处理方式、下游头部、超参调优策略和基线。为此作者提出 PPG-Bench，一个开源统一基准，覆盖九个开放数据集与 26 项任务，对五个公开 PPG 基础模型进行评测。它旨在为 PPG 基础模型提供可复现、可对比的评价标准。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.13435v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photoplethysmography (PPG) is increasingly recorded by wearable and clinical devices at enormous scale, and a growing number of PPG foundation models (FMs) have been developed to compute reusable representations for various downstream tasks. These models are difficult to compare: different evaluations use different datasets, task definitions, preprocessing, downstream heads, hyperparameter tuning, and baselines. We present PPG-Bench, a unifying open-source benchmark evaluating five public PPG FMs across nine open-access datasets and 26 tasks span…
items.why_zh: 为快速增长的 PPG 基础模型提供统一、可复现的评测口径，便于公平比较与选型。
items.why_en: It gives a unified, reproducible evaluation standard for the fast-growing field of PPG foundation models.

items.title_zh: 为何重尾权重谱能预测模型质量
items.title_en: Why Heavy-Tailed Weight Spectra Predict Model Quality
items.summary_zh: 人们对深度神经网络（DNN）为何能预测成功仍缺乏透彻理解。现有许多数据依赖型指标试图预测 DNN 的模型质量，但它们在大数据集上计算代价高昂，且在训练数据未公开时可能完全无法计算。一种实用而有效的替代思路是分析 DNN 权重矩阵：此前工作已发现，训练后权重矩阵中的重尾谱分布对模型质量具有很强的预测能力。本文进一步探讨这一现象背后的原因。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.13123v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A solid understanding of the predictive success of deep neural networks (DNNs) remains elusive. For example, while many data-dependent metrics exist that seek to predict model quality of DNNs, these metrics may be expensive to compute for large datasets and/or may be impossible to compute when training datasets are not released. A practical and effective predictor of model quality involves analyzing DNN weight matrices, as prior work has established that heavy-tailed spectral distributions in trained weight matrices can be strongly predictive o…
items.why_zh: 仅凭模型权重即可评估质量，为无法获取训练数据的场景提供廉价可靠的模型诊断手段。
items.why_en: Weight-only quality prediction offers a cheap, reliable diagnostic when training data cannot be released.

items.title_zh: 视频生成的“黄金锚点”
items.title_en: Golden Anchor for Video Generation
items.summary_zh: 视频生成支撑数字内容创作，应用涵盖虚拟化身、AI 驱动影视制作、交互式游戏引擎与世界模型。当前最先进系统主要通过图生视频（I2V）实现可控性：注入的锚点图像决定了生成视频的身份、构图与风格。在现代流程中，这张锚点图通常由文生图（T2I）生成器合成。由此引出一个此前较少被关注的问题：直接由 T2I 模型得到的图像，是否真的适合充当视频生成的锚点？
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.13217v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Video generation supports digital content creation, with applications in virtual avatars, AI-driven filmmaking, interactive game engines, and world models. State-of-the-art systems achieve controllability primarily through image-to-video (I2V) generation, in which an injected anchor image determines the identity, composition, and style of the resulting video. In modern pipelines, this anchor is synthesized by a text-to-image (T2I) generator. This raises a largely overlooked question: Are images obtained directly from the T2I model truly suitabl…
items.why_zh: 锚点图质量直接决定 I2V 视频的身份与风格一致性，该问题触及生成流程的关键假设。
items.why_en: Anchor-image quality governs identity and style consistency in I2V, making this a key assumption in modern pipelines.

items.title_zh: ERIS：用联邦分片聚合改善联邦学习的隐私—效用—可扩展性权衡
items.title_en: ERIS: Enhancing the Privacy-Utility-Scalability Trade-Off in Federated Learning via Federated Shard Aggregation
items.summary_zh: 将联邦学习（FL）扩展到十亿参数级模型，会在隐私、可扩展性与模型效用之间形成棘手的三方权衡。现有方案往往孤立地应对其中某一项：或牺牲精度，或依赖昂贵的密码学工具，或引入影响收敛的通信与优化低效。作者提出 ERIS 框架，其核心是联邦分片聚合（Federated Shard Aggregation, FSA）：把每个客户端更新切分为互不重叠的分片，并以分布式方式对各分片进行聚合。该机制旨在同时缓解上述三类瓶颈。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2602.08617v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Scaling Federated Learning (FL) to billion-parameter models forces a challenging trade-off between privacy, scalability, and model utility. Existing solutions often tackle these challenges in isolation, sacrificing accuracy, relying on costly cryptographic tools, or introducing communication and optimization inefficiencies that affect convergence. We introduce ERIS, an FL framework centered on Federated Shard Aggregation (FSA), a novel mechanism that partitions each client update into non-overlapping shards whose aggregation is distributed ac…
items.why_zh: 提出同时兼顾隐私、可扩展性与效用的联邦学习机制，为大模型联邦训练提供新路径。
items.why_en: It offers a mechanism that jointly addresses privacy, scalability and utility for federated training of large models.

items.title_zh: 超越分布内保持：用面向脆弱性的调优恢复量化 VLA 的泛化能力
items.title_en: Beyond In-Distribution Preservation: Recovering Generalization in Quantized VLAs via Vulnerability-Oriented Tuning
items.summary_zh: 已有研究表明，训练后量化在标准评测条件下能够保持视觉—语言—动作（VLA）模型的性能，但它是否同样保留了全精度模型的鲁棒性与泛化能力，仍缺乏充分探索。本文系统研究了后量化 VLA 策略在环境扰动下的鲁棒性与泛化表现。实证结果显示，量化后的策略尽管在分布内性能相当，却可能对细微的环境变化变得脆弱。研究还观察到动作层面的差异（action discrepancy）现象，并据此提出面向脆弱性的调优方法来恢复泛化能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.05745v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Post-training quantization has been shown to preserve VLA performance under standard evaluation conditions, but whether it preserves the full-precision model's robustness and generalization remains underexplored. In this study, we systematically study the robustness and generalization of post-quantized VLA policies under environmental disturbances. Empirical results show that quantized policies can become fragile to subtle environmental variations despite retaining comparable in-distribution performance. We further observe that action discrep…
items.why_zh: 提醒量化 VLA 在真实扰动下可能失效，并提供恢复鲁棒性的实用调优方案。
items.why_en: It warns that quantized VLA policies can fail under real-world disturbances and offers a practical fix.

items.title_zh: 通过正交化动量实现非光滑优化
items.title_en: Nonsmooth Optimization via Orthogonalized Momentum
items.summary_zh: 现代实际应用问题常涉及矩阵值参数，而传统优化器把它们当作向量处理，这催生了利用输入—输出几何结构的矩阵感知方法，例如在更新参数前对动量矩阵做正交化的 Muon。Muon 的经验性成功引出一个概念性问题：正交化动量在光滑优化之外是否依然有效？本文针对局部 Lipschitz 函数研究这一问题，采用与反向传播兼容的广义导数框架，探讨正交化动量在非光滑设定下的行为。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.13677v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Modern real application problems involve matrix-valued parameters, yet conventional optimizers treat them as vectors, thereby motivating matrix-aware methods that exploit input-output geometry, such as Muon which orthogonalizes the momentum matrices before parameter updates. Its empirical success raises a conceptual question: can orthogonalized momentum remain effective beyond smooth optimization? This paper studies this question for locally Lipschitz functions using a generalized derivative framework compatible with backpropagation. Ou…
items.why_zh: 把 Muon 式正交化动量推广到非光滑优化，拓展了矩阵感知优化器的理论边界。
items.why_en: It extends Muon-style orthogonalized momentum into nonsmooth optimization, broadening the theory of matrix-aware optimizers.

items.title_zh: 用 CoMoE 在消费级 GPU 上普及 MoE 推理
items.title_en: Democratizing MoE inference on commodity GPUs with CoMoE
items.summary_zh: 部署 Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）模型高度依赖专家并行，由此产生密集的 GPU 间通信。因此，最先进的推理系统需要数据中心 GPU 提供的高带宽点对点互连（如 NVLink）来应对海量 token 路由，使部署成本高得难以为继。消费级 GPU 以低得多的价格提供相近的算力，有望让个人也能运行 MoE 推理并支持隐私保护的本地部署，但它们受限于带宽。CoMoE 针对这一矛盾提出解决方案（摘要原文在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.09424v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Deploying Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models relies heavily on Expert Parallelism, which generates intense inter-GPU communication. Consequently, state-of-the-art inference systems require high-bandwidth, P2P interconnects (e.g., NVLink) in datacenter GPUs to handle massive token routing, making deployment prohibitively expensive. Consumer GPUs offer comparable compute power at significantly lower cost, promising to democratize MoE inference for individuals and enable privacy-preserving local deployments. However, their bandwidth-limited (…
items.why_zh: 若能绕开 NVLink 等昂贵互连，MoE 推理将可在消费级硬件上本地化、低成本运行。
items.why_en: If it avoids costly interconnects like NVLink, MoE inference could run locally and cheaply on consumer hardware.

items.title_zh: HPE 确认英伟达将推出 Rubin PCIe GPU

items.summary_en: HPE's presentation materials shared with outlets including The Next Platform confirm that its ProLiant DL585a Gen13 server supports Nvidia's Rubin PCIe GPU. Existing Rubin GPUs are data-center parts in the SMX form factor drawing up to 2,300W, so a PCIe version would likely require a much smaller die and lower clocks — or could instead be an RTX PRO-class chip based on the rumored GR202 core. The 10U DL585a Gen13 hosts two AMD EPYC 9006 CPUs and supports up to eight double-width or 16 single-width cards.
items.why_zh: HPE 的服务器资料等于提前透露了英伟达尚未发布的 Rubin PCIe 产品，暗示下一代 GPU 可能同时覆盖 SMX 与 PCIe 两种形态。
items.why_en: HPE's server document effectively pre-announces an unreleased Nvidia Rubin PCIe product, hinting the next-gen GPU line may span both SMX and PCIe form factors.

items.why_zh: 连续多篇报道指向同一笔潜在交易，显示亚马逊正加快 AI 布局，70 亿美元的价码也反映头部 AI 资产的高估值。
items.why_en: Multiple reports pointing to the same potential deal suggest Amazon is accelerating its AI push, and the $7 billion price tag reflects how highly top AI assets are valued.

items.title_zh: 小鹏智驾出海欧洲：两周微调适配一个国家，计划 2027 年落地 NGP
items.title_en: XPeng Smart Driving in Europe: Two-Week Adaptation per Country, NGP Planned for 2027
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 12 日消息，据彭博社报道，在巴黎车展前夕，小鹏汽车通用智能中心负责人刘先明接受采访时透露，该公司成功在约两周时间内，将智驾系统从一个欧洲国家微调适配到另一个欧洲国家。 刘先明指出，这一适配过程所需的数据量，仅为训练底层人工智能基础模型所需数据的万分之一。 我们只需利用非常少量的本地数据，就能完成模型在当地的对齐（即适配当地的道路环境）。 据刘先明介绍，小鹏目前正与欧洲监管机构紧密沟通，并维持在 2027 年于欧洲正式落地智能导航辅助驾驶系统（NGP）的原定规划。 刘先明强调， 小鹏汽车致力于将全功能版智驾系统带入欧洲 ，而非妥协推出“阉割版”。除基础的车道保持与自适应巡航外，该技术能应对复杂的城市与高速路况，涵盖交通标识识别、避让骑行者，以及顺应欧洲城市特有的驾驶习惯。 据IT之家此前报道， 小鹏集团将携物理 AI 全品类产品亮相巴黎车展 ，届时将展出小鹏 G9L、MONA L03、小鹏 P7+、小鹏 G6、小鹏 G9、小鹏 X9 车型，以及陆地航母、IRON 机器人。
items.summary_en: Ahead of the Paris auto show, XPeng's Liu Xianming told Bloomberg the company can fine-tune its smart-driving system from one European country to another in about two weeks, using roughly 0.01% of the data needed to train its underlying AI foundation model. XPeng says it remains in close contact with European regulators and still plans to launch its NGP assisted-driving system in Europe in 2027, in full-featured rather than stripped-down form. The company will also show the G9L, MONA L03, P7+, G6, G9 and X9 alongside its 'Land Aircraft Carrier' and IRON robot in Paris.
items.why_zh: 若 2027 年如期落地，小鹏将成为少数在欧洲提供全功能高阶智驾的中国车企，并验证“少量本地数据、快速适配”的出海路径。
items.why_en: If it hits its 2027 target, XPeng would be one of few Chinese automakers offering full-featured advanced driver assistance in Europe, validating a 'small local data, fast adaptation' playbook.

items.title_zh: 亚马逊据悉洽谈 70 亿美元收购 Decart，Anthropic 退出后接盘
items.title_en: Amazon Reportedly in Talks to Acquire AI Startup Decart for $7 Billion, Stepping In After Anthropic Walked Away
items.summary_zh: 据 BigGo Finance 报道，亚马逊正就收购 AI 初创公司 Decart 进行洽谈，交易金额约 70 亿美元，此前 Anthropic 曾参与洽谈但最终退出，亚马逊随之“接盘”。报道未披露谈判所处阶段、交易结构以及 Decart 的具体技术与产品方向。若交易成行，这将成为亚马逊在 AI 领域规模最大的并购之一，也说明优质 AI 标的正在被多家巨头同时争夺。
items.summary_en: Amazon Reportedly in Talks to Acquire AI Startup Decart for $7 Billion, Stepping In After Anthropic Walked Away BigGo Finance
items.why_zh: 该报道显示优质 AI 资产正被多家巨头同时争抢，亚马逊的介入印证其 AI 并购步伐正在加快。
items.why_en: The report shows premium AI assets are being pursued by multiple giants at once, and Amazon's move underscores the accelerating pace of its AI M&A.

items.title_zh: 联想推出 AI Express，提供预验证的 AI 工厂系统
items.title_en: Lenovo Launches AI Express With Prevalidated AI Factory Systems - THE ELEC, Korea Electronics Industry Media
items.summary_zh: 据 THE ELEC 报道，联想发布 AI Express 方案，主打“预验证（prevalidated）的 AI 工厂系统”，即为企业提供预先完成验证与集成的 AI 基础设施组合，帮助客户更快部署 AI 算力与工作负载。报道未披露具体系统配置、定价与上市时间。此举显示服务器厂商正围绕“开箱即用”的企业级 AI 基础设施展开竞争。
items.summary_en: Lenovo Launches AI Express With Prevalidated AI Factory Systems THE ELEC, Korea Electronics Industry Media
items.why_zh: 预验证的一体化 AI 基础设施能缩短企业上线 AI 的周期，正成为服务器厂商在企业级 AI 市场争夺的新卖点。
items.why_en: Pre-validated, integrated AI infrastructure shortens enterprise time-to-AI deployment and is becoming a key selling point for server vendors in the enterprise AI market.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 推出办公工具，新增自然语言数据可视化
items.title_en: Anthropic Launches Office Tools, Adds Natural-Language Data Visualization - THE ELEC, Korea Electronics Industry Media
items.summary_zh: 据 THE ELEC 报道，Anthropic 发布面向办公场景的工具，并新增基于自然语言的数据可视化能力，用户可通过自然语言指令完成数据的图表化呈现。这意味着 Anthropic 正把生成式 AI 能力从模型接口进一步延伸到日常办公与数据分析环节。报道未披露具体功能细节与定价，也未说明该工具的可用范围。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Launches Office Tools, Adds Natural-Language Data Visualization THE ELEC, Korea Electronics Industry Media
items.why_zh: 大模型厂商正从 API 供应走向办公生产力软件，直接与微软、Google 争夺企业办公入口。
items.why_en: Model makers are moving from API supply into office productivity software, competing directly with Microsoft and Google for the enterprise workplace.

items.title_zh: 英国将加强网络防御，AI 国务大臣呼吁人工智能企业加大安全保障力度
items.title_en: UK to Boost Cyber Defenses as AI Minister Urges Firms to Step Up Safety
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 12 日消息，据《卫报》报道，英国将加强其网络防御，同时呼吁顶尖人工智能研发企业在系统安全治理上采取更积极的举措。 英国 AI 国务大臣卡尼什卡 · 纳拉扬（Kanishka Narayan）预计将在西伦敦发表的专题演讲中正式宣布上述政策主张。 纳拉扬将呼吁前沿人工智能研发企业采取更多切实举措保障系统安全。IT之家获悉，纳拉扬表示， 英国绝不能完全依赖科技巨头对其模型进行“自我监管” ，并强调英国本土必须构建更多自主可控的 AI 基础设施。 延伸阅读 据英国政府官网资料，卡尼什卡 · 纳拉扬于 2026 年 7 月 20 日被任命为人工智能国务大臣，同时在英国内阁办公室以及商业、创新、科学与贸易部（BIST）任职。他此前于 2025 年 9 月 7 日至 2026 年 7 月 20 日担任科学、创新与技术部（DSIT）的议会副国务大臣，并于 2024 年 7 月当选威尔士格拉摩根谷选区议员。 纳拉扬分管的内阁办公室职责中包括人工智能安全研究院（AI Security Institute，AISI）。该机构旨在构建人工智能风险的证据基础，为政府决策提供参考。据英国议会 2026 年 4 月披露的信息，AISI 已与 OpenAI、谷歌 DeepMind、Anthropic 等领先 AI 公司合作测试了超过 30 个模型，其发现会在模型部署前促成实际改动。 2025…
items.summary_en: The UK plans to strengthen its cyber defenses and is calling on leading AI developers to do more to secure their systems, according to The Guardian. AI Minister Kanishka Narayan is expected to say in a London speech that Britain cannot rely on tech giants to "self-regulate" their models and must build more of its own AI infrastructure. He oversees the AI Security Institute, which has tested more than 30 models with OpenAI, Google DeepMind and Anthropic.
items.why_zh: 这体现政府层面对前沿 AI 安全治理的介入加强，并可能推动英国本土 AI 基础设施与监管框架建设。
items.why_en: It signals stronger government involvement in frontier AI safety and could advance UK-built AI infrastructure and regulation.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 放弃后，消息称亚马逊洽谈收购初创公司 Decart、看中 AI 芯片切换软件
items.title_en: Amazon in Talks to Buy AI Startup Decart at About $7 Billion Valuation
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 12 日消息，据华尔街日报消息，据知情人士透露，亚马逊正就收购人工智能初创公司 Decart 展开谈判， 该笔交易的潜在估值约为 70 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 469.48 亿元人民币） 。 总部位于旧金山的 Decart 专注于研发跨芯片适配软件，能够帮助开发者在不同 AI 芯片之间无缝切换。随着各大科技巨头纷纷竞逐算力资源，这一底层软件能力正变得愈发关键。 知情人士指出，若谈判进展顺利且未出现新的竞购方，该交易或将很快达成。 研究机构 PitchBook 的数据显示，Decart 此前已从红杉资本、Benchmark 以及 Radical Ventures 等知名风投机构累计筹集逾 4 亿美元 （现汇率约合 26.83 亿元人民币） 。在今年 5 月的一轮融资中，其估值已接近 40 亿美元 （现汇率约合 268.27 亿元人民币） 。 IT之家注意到，据彭博社 8 月报道， Anthropic 曾洽谈收购 Decart ，交易金额约为 60 亿美元 （现汇率约合 402.41 亿元人民币） 。今年 9 月，报道称 Anthropic 已放弃收购 Decart 。
items.summary_en: Amazon is in talks to acquire San Francisco-based AI startup Decart at a potential valuation of about $7 billion, The Wall Street Journal reports. Decart develops cross-chip software that lets developers switch seamlessly between different AI chips, a capability growing more critical amid the compute race. Anthropic reportedly walked away from a roughly $6 billion deal in September.
items.why_zh: 这表明算力竞争正从芯片硬件延伸到跨芯片软件层，头部云厂商正通过收购补齐这一关键能力。
items.why_en: It shows the compute race extending from chips into cross-chip software, with cloud giants buying into a critical layer.

items.title_zh: SoftBank’s Next $100 Billion Underscores Ray Dalio’s AI Warning
items.title_en: SoftBank's Next $100 Billion Underscores Ray Dalio's AI Warning
items.summary_zh: SoftBank’s Next $100 Billion Underscores Ray Dalio’s AI Warning Bloomberg.com
items.summary_en: Bloomberg reports that SoftBank's next $100 billion investment underscores Ray Dalio's warning about AI. The headline points to the scale of AI spending at a time of rising concern over AI-related risks. Details on the deployment of the funds and Dalio's remarks were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 巨额资本继续涌入 AI 与风险警告并存，反映出市场对 AI 估值与投资节奏的分歧正在加大。
items.why_en: Huge capital keeps flowing into AI even as warnings mount, highlighting deepening disagreement over AI valuations and investment pace.

items.title_zh: 分析：布卢明顿拟禁"超级智能"，权限与执法存疑
items.title_en: Analysis: Bloomington’s proposed superintelligence ban raises questions about authority, enforcement
items.summary_zh: 美国印第安纳州布卢明顿市提出一项禁止"超级智能"的提案，当地媒体《B Square Bulletin》就此发表分析文章。文章指出，该提案引出两个核心疑问：一是地方政府是否具备对"超级智能"这类前沿技术立法的权限，二是即便提案通过，实际执法也将面临重重困难。原文并未给出结论，而是把讨论焦点放在管辖权归属与落地机制上。这类尝试表明，围绕 AI 治理的争论正从联邦和州层面下探到城市一级。
items.summary_en: Analysis: Bloomington’s proposed superintelligence ban raises questions about authority, enforcement The B Square Bulletin
items.why_zh: 它凸显了 AI 监管中"谁来管、怎么管"的制度空白，地方立法可能成为新的试验场。
items.why_en: It highlights the governance gap over who regulates advanced AI and how, with local legislation emerging as a new testing ground.

items.title_zh: Hack The Box 推出 AI Range 企业版，衡量 AI 智能体的网络安全能力
items.title_en: Hack The Box Launches AI Range Enterprise Edition to Measure AI Agent Competence in Cybersecurity
items.summary_zh: 网络安全平台 Hack The Box 宣布推出 AI Range 企业版，旨在评估 AI 智能体在网络安全领域的实际能力。该产品面向企业客户，提供专门的环境来测试和衡量 AI 代理在安全任务中的表现。随着 AI 代理越来越多地参与威胁检测、漏洞分析等工作，如何验证其可靠性成为关键问题。此举有望为企业采用 AI 安全工具提供量化的参考依据。
items.summary_en: Hack The Box Launches AI Range Enterprise Edition to Measure AI Agent Competence in Cybersecurity Cybersecurity Insiders
items.why_zh: 随着 AI 代理进入网络安全领域，量化评估其能力对安全部署至关重要。
items.why_en: As AI agents enter cybersecurity, quantifying their competence is critical for safe deployment.

items.title_zh: 古尔曼：苹果首款智能家庭中枢定名 HomeView，搭载 A18 芯片、四种配色可选
items.title_en: Gurman: Apple's First Smart Home Hub Is Named HomeView, With A18 Chip and Four Colors
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 11 日消息，彭博社记者马克 · 古尔曼今日在新一期《Power On》通讯中透露，苹果首款智能家庭中枢名为“HomeView”，预计将在 10 月 13 日的“欢迎回家”活动正式发布，11 月出货。 据介绍，这款产品的外观设计类似 iMac G4“台灯电脑”，采用悬浮式屏幕，下方配有扬声器底座。 该设备将搭载 A18 芯片 ，官方还将推出壁挂安装版本。 IT之家从原报道获悉， 这款新产品将提供深空灰、银色、星光色和粉色四种配色 ，壁挂版仅有深空灰、银色两种配色。 古尔曼表示，这款产品主要使用语音交互， 以 AI Siri 为核心 。用户可以在房间另一端查看设备显示内容，并且该产品将运行苹果自家 App，但不支持 App Store。用户或许可以使用 iPhone，将第三方应用的小组件投射到设备上。
items.summary_en: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports Apple's first smart home hub will be called HomeView, expected to debut at an October 13 "Welcome Home" event and ship in November. It reportedly uses a floating screen atop a speaker base, runs an A18 chip, offers a wall-mount version and four colors, and centers on voice-first AI Siri with Apple apps only — no App Store.
items.why_zh: 这是苹果首次正式进军智能家庭中枢品类，其产品形态与封闭生态策略将直接影响它在智能家居市场与亚马逊、谷歌的竞争位置。
items.why_en: It marks Apple's first real entry into the smart home hub category, shaping how it competes with Amazon and Google in the connected-home market.

items.title_zh: 博通向 Anthropic 提供 420 亿美元“贷款”，押注 2 万亿美元级 IPO
items.title_en: How Broadcom’s $42 Billion ‘Loan’ to Anthropic Is a Bet on a $2 Trillion IPO
items.summary_zh: 有报道称，博通（Broadcom）向 AI 公司 Anthropic 提供了规模约 420 亿美元的“贷款”，此举被解读为对 Anthropic 未来上市的一次押注，相关 IPO 的估值预期被指向 2 万亿美元量级。目前公开信息有限，交易的具体结构、资金用途、利率与还款安排均未披露，博通与 Anthropic 也没有给出更多说明。若消息属实，这将进一步加深芯片与基础设施供应商同头部 AI 模型公司之间的资本与业务绑定。
items.summary_en: How Broadcom’s $42 Billion ‘Loan’ to Anthropic Is a Bet on a $2 Trillion IPO Barchart.com
items.why_zh: 若属实，这笔巨额资金安排显示 AI 基础设施供应商正以资本手段深度绑定头部模型公司，可能重塑行业竞争与算力供应链格局。
items.why_en: If confirmed, such a massive financing shows AI infrastructure suppliers using capital to lock in leading model developers, potentially reshaping competition and the compute supply chain.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 推出免费 AI 安全扫描器，帮开源项目发现并修复漏洞
items.title_en: Copy of Anthropic Launches Free AI Security Scanner To Help Open-Source Projects Find and Fix Vulnerabilities
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 发布了一款免费的 AI 安全扫描工具，目标是帮助开源项目发现并修复代码中的安全漏洞。开源项目长期面临人力有限、安全审查跟不上的困境，此类工具可降低漏洞排查与修复的门槛。目前已知信息有限，官方尚未披露该工具的技术细节、覆盖的编程语言范围以及上线与推广的时间安排。这一举措被视为 Anthropic 将模型能力延伸到软件供应链安全领域的一次尝试。
items.summary_en: Copy of Anthropic Launches Free AI Security Scanner To Help Open-Source Projects Find and Fix Vulnerabilities LinkedIn
items.why_zh: 开源软件是整个软件生态的底座，用 AI 自动发现漏洞有望降低安全维护门槛、减少下游供应链风险。
items.why_en: Open-source code underpins most software, so AI-driven vulnerability detection could lower security maintenance barriers and reduce downstream supply-chain risk.

items.title_zh: The Sequence Radar 第 948 期：上周 AI 要闻——数十亿美元融资、数百篇论文、一次大跨越？
items.title_en: The Sequence Radar - Issue 948: Last Week in AI: Billions in Funding, Hundreds of Papers, One Big Leap?
items.summary_zh: 由 The Sequence 出品的资讯通讯《The Sequence Radar》发布第 948 期，回顾了上周 AI 领域的主要动态，内容涵盖数十亿美元规模的融资、数百篇新论文，以及被其称为“一次大跨越”的潜在技术进展。该栏目由 Jesus Rodriguez 主笔，定位是面向从业者的周期性行业速览，帮助读者快速把握融资、研究与技术突破的整体节奏。本期具体条目与结论需查阅原文。
items.summary_en: The Sequence Radar - Issue 948: Last Week in AI: Billions in Funding, Hundreds of Papers, One Big Leap? TheSequence | Jesus Rodriguez
items.why_zh: 作为面向从业者的周期速览，这类通讯能帮助读者快速判断融资、研究与技术突破的整体节奏与走向。
items.why_en: As a widely read periodic roundup, it helps practitioners quickly gauge the overall pace of funding, research and technical breakthroughs.

items.title_zh: 《VRChat》更新创作者指南：禁止使用 AI 生成误导性地图 / 角色缩略图，尚未决定上线“AI 标签”声明
items.title_en: VRChat Updates Creator Guidelines: Bans Misleading AI-Generated Thumbnails, AI Labels Still Undecided
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 11 日消息，《VRChat》开发商 VRChat Inc. 于 10 月 7 日公布了针对 AI 生成内容的应对方针，同步更新创作者指南。官方明确禁止使用 AI 生成误导性地图 / 角色缩略图，避免创作者利用与实际内容完全不符的缩略图吸引玩家点击。 《VRChat》指出，平台一直将“自由表达”“人类无限的创造力”以及“人与人之间的联系”视为核心价值，尽管 AI 技术提升了开发人员的效率，然而其也催生了大量低质量内容，事实上在 AI 普及之前，平台上就已经存在一批低质量地图 / 角色，而 AI 的出现进一步降低了批量制作和发布内容的门槛，使大量低劣作品涌入平台，优质内容也更容易被淹没。 《VRChat》还透露，内部团队对于 AI 的看法同样存在分歧。部分员工会利用 AI 自动化工作流程或弥补自身知识短板，另一些员工则对 AI 持有较深的疑虑。近期，VRChat 网站便发生了一起意外事件：原本用于页面布局的 AI 占位符美术素材被错误地放到了正式上线的网页中，导致平台口碑声誉下降。 针对玩家关注的“AI 标签”声明内容，VRChat 认为，尽管此类声明内容能够帮助玩家快速辨别哪些项目利用了 AI，但目前内部团队尚未达成明确共识。因此， VRChat 对推出 AI 标签制度持开放态度，但尚未承诺一定会实施 。 除了 AI 政策外，后续 VRChat 还计划在游戏内加…
items.summary_en: VRChat updated its creator guidelines to ban AI-generated thumbnails that mislead users about map or avatar content, saying AI lowers the barrier to mass-producing low-quality content. It also disclosed divided internal views on AI after placeholder AI art mistakenly appeared on its live site, and said it is open to but has not committed to an "AI label" system.
items.why_zh: 这反映了 UGC 平台在 AI 内容大量涌入时，如何平衡创作者自由、内容质量与用户信任这一普遍难题。
items.why_en: It highlights the broader challenge UGC platforms face in balancing creator freedom, content quality and user trust amid a flood of AI-generated content.

items.title_zh: 国产AI性能标杆 Kimi K3.1月中发布：K4要冲5-6万亿参数
items.title_en: China's AI Flagship: Kimi K3.1 Lands Mid-Month, K4 Targets 5-6 Trillion Parameters
items.summary_zh: 国产AI性能标杆 Kimi K3.1月中发布：K4要冲5-6万亿参数 驱动之家
items.summary_en: Kimi is set to release K3.1 in the middle of this month, while its next-generation K4 is reportedly targeting 5–6 trillion parameters. If realized, that scale would place K4 among the world's largest models, though official details on capabilities, timing and training costs remain undisclosed.
items.why_zh: 参数规模与迭代速度是衡量国产大模型竞争力的关键指标，K3.1 与 K4 的进展将影响国内头部模型的第一梯队格局。
items.why_en: Model scale and iteration speed are key gauges of China's frontier model competitiveness, so K3.1 and K4 progress will shape the domestic top tier.

items.title_zh: 国产AI性能标杆 Kimi K3.1月中发布：K4要冲5-6万亿参数
items.title_en: Kimi K3.1 to Launch Mid-Month, With K4 Targeting 5-6 Trillion Parameters
items.summary_zh: 国产AI性能标杆 Kimi K3.1月中发布：K4要冲5-6万亿参数 快科技
items.summary_en: Kimi will release version K3.1 in the middle of this month, according to Kuai Technology, while its next model, K4, is targeting 5-6 trillion parameters. The plan points to rapid iteration aimed at scaling up Chinese models into the global super-large-parameter tier.
items.why_zh: 若K4达到5-6万亿参数，将是国产大模型在规模上的重要跃升，直接影响中美模型能力竞争的格局。
items.why_en: A 5-6 trillion-parameter K4 would mark a major scale leap for Chinese models and shape the global race in frontier AI capability.

items.title_en: Kimi K3.1 Reportedly Due Mid-Month, K4 Targeting 5–6 Trillion Parameters

items.summary_en: According to Sina Finance, Kimi's next release, K3.1, is expected mid-month, while the following K4 model is targeted at 5–6 trillion parameters. No further technical details or timelines were disclosed.
items.why_zh: 参数规模与迭代速度是衡量国产大模型竞争力的重要指标，K3.1 与 K4 的进展因此备受关注。
items.why_en: Parameter scale and release cadence are key gauges of China's frontier model competitiveness, making K3.1 and K4 closely watched.

items.title_zh: 微软发布新款自研 AI 芯片，称其为最大押注，以减少对 Nvidia 依赖
items.title_en: Microsoft makes ‘biggest bet yet’ on its own silicon, unveils new AI chip to reduce reliance on Nvidia
items.summary_zh: 据 GeekWire 报道，微软发布了新款自研 AI 芯片，并称这是其在自有芯片上迄今最大的一笔押注。该芯片的目标是降低微软对 Nvidia GPU 的依赖。现有信息未披露芯片名称、规格、量产时间或性能指标。此举延续了大型云厂商自研 AI 芯片、控制成本与供应链风险的行业趋势。
items.summary_en: Microsoft makes ‘biggest bet yet’ on its own silicon, unveils new AI chip to reduce reliance on Nvidia GeekWire
items.why_zh: 云巨头自研芯片可能改变 AI 算力供应格局，并削弱 Nvidia 在 AI 芯片市场的议价能力。
items.why_en: Cloud giants’ custom silicon could reshape AI compute supply and weaken Nvidia’s pricing power.

items.title_zh: 微软发布第三代 Maia 300 AI 芯片，降低对 Nvidia GPU 依赖
items.title_en: Microsoft’s new AI chip makes it less reliant on Nvidia’s GPUs
items.summary_zh: 微软今日发布第三代自研 AI 芯片 Maia 300，定位为微软产品与服务的“主要 AI 推理系统”。该芯片旨在改善云端 AI 工作负载的成本与效率，并更有能力处理最新推理模型和智能体任务。Maia 300 计划于 2027 年开始投入生产，设计上强调能效；微软预计其每兆瓦 token 产出比领先的 GPU 系统高 40%。
items.summary_en: Microsoft’s Maia 300 chip. | Image: Microsoft Microsoft is announcing its third-generation Maia in-house AI chip today, designed to be the "primary AI inference system" for Microsoft's products and services. Maia 300 not only improves the cost and efficiency of running AI workloads in the cloud, it's also more capable of handling the latest reasoning models and agentic tasks. Maia 300 will start being rolled out to production in 2027, and it has been designed with efficiency in mind. "We expect Maia 300 to deliver 40 percent more tokens per megawatt compared to leading GPU-based systems," says…
items.why_zh: 若 Maia 300 按计划落地，微软可减少对 Nvidia GPU 的依赖，并降低大规模 AI 推理的成本与能耗。
items.why_en: If Maia 300 ships as planned, Microsoft could cut its reliance on Nvidia GPUs and lower the cost and energy use of large-scale AI inference.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek领投前腾讯科学家创立的机器人初创公司Winverse AI 提供者 Investing.com

items.why_en: A large-model company backing a robotics startup highlights rising interest in the convergence of AI and embodied intelligence.

items.title_zh: Ondas 与 Palantir 成立 Regna AI，开发面向国防行动的主权人工智能

items.summary_zh: Ondas 与 Palantir 宣布推出 Regna AI，目标是开发面向国防行动的主权人工智能。主权 AI 通常指由本国或本组织控制、满足数据主权与安全合规要求的 AI 系统。目前公开信息未披露 Regna AI 的具体产品形态、投资规模、客户或上线时间。
items.summary_en: Ondas and Palantir Launch Regna AI to Develop Sovereign Artificial Intelligence for Defence Operations Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: 国防领域对自主可控 AI 的需求上升，Palantir 等厂商正加速布局主权 AI。
items.why_en: Defence agencies increasingly want sovereign, controllable AI, and companies like Palantir are moving to serve that demand.

items.title_zh: TikTok CEO 周受资预测 AI 将带来科学突破
items.title_en: TikTok CEO Shou Zi Chew predicts AI scientific breakthroughs
items.summary_zh: TikTok CEO 周受资预测，人工智能将推动科学领域取得突破。现有报道没有说明他具体看好哪些科学方向、时间表或应用场景。作为头部社交平台高管，他的表态反映出科技行业对 AI 加速科研发现的普遍期待。
items.summary_en: TikTok CEO Shou Zi Chew predicts AI scientific breakthroughs Quartz
items.why_zh: AI 在科研中的应用被视为下一波重要机遇，头部平台高管的判断受到关注。
items.why_en: AI’s use in scientific research is seen as a major next opportunity, making predictions from top platform executives noteworthy.

items.title_zh: 英国重新获得 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 模型的发布前访问权
items.title_en: U.K. regains access to OpenAI and Anthropic AI models pre-release
items.summary_zh: 据 Quartz 报道，英国重新获得了在正式发布前访问 OpenAI 和 Anthropic AI 模型的权限。此前英国为何失去该权限、此次恢复的条件以及涉及哪些具体模型，现有信息未作说明。此类预发布访问通常用于政府安全评估和监管审查，是前沿 AI 治理的重要环节。
items.summary_en: U.K. regains access to OpenAI and Anthropic AI models pre-release Quartz
items.why_zh: 政府能否在模型发布前进行评估，直接关系到前沿 AI 的安全监管能力。
items.why_en: Whether governments can assess models before release is central to frontier AI safety oversight.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 被迫禁止模型访问互联网，以防其“失控”
items.title_en: Anthropic forced to ban models from the internet to stop them going ‘rogue’
items.summary_zh: 报道称，Anthropic 被迫禁止其 AI 模型访问互联网，以防止模型出现“失控”（rogue）行为。现有摘要未说明涉及哪些模型、发生了什么具体事件，以及“失控”指的是安全测试中的何种表现。这一举措凸显出前沿 AI 公司在模型自主性与安全风险上的担忧，并可能采取网络隔离等控制手段。
items.summary_en: Anthropic forced to ban models from the internet to stop them going ‘rogue’ Yahoo Finance UK
items.why_zh: 反映前沿模型自主性带来的安全风险，以及厂商在部署中采取隔离措施的必要性。
items.why_en: It highlights safety risks from model autonomy and the need for containment measures during deployment.

items.title_en: Tencent proposes medium-term notes; $5 billion bond reportedly for AI capex
items.summary_zh: 腾讯控股建议发行中期票据 据悉50亿美元债券用于AI资本开支 观点网

items.title_zh: QGIS 禁止 AI 辅助贡献
items.title_en: QGIS bans AI assisted contributions

items.summary_en: Article URL: https://github.com/qgis/QGIS-Enhancement-Proposals/pull/387 Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50054751 Points: 178 # Comments: 137
items.why_zh: 开源项目对 AI 贡献的禁令可能引发其他项目效仿，并加剧关于 AI 在开源协作中角色的辩论。
items.why_en: The ban by an open-source project could set a precedent and intensify debates over AI's role in open-source collaboration.

items.title_zh: 英伟达洽谈收购或追加投资 Reflection AI
items.title_en: Nvidia in talks to acquire or invest further in Reflection AI
items.summary_zh: 据 Quartz 报道，英伟达正在就收购或进一步投资 AI 初创公司 Reflection AI 进行谈判。交易的具体金额和条款尚未披露。此举若达成，将进一步扩大英伟达在人工智能领域的投资版图，加强其在 AI 生态中的影响力。
items.summary_en: Nvidia in talks to acquire or invest further in Reflection AI Quartz
items.why_zh: 英伟达持续加码 AI 初创企业投资，可能重塑 AI 竞争格局。
items.why_en: Nvidia's continued investment in AI startups could reshape the competitive landscape.

items.title_zh: 英特尔、博通 CEO 齐发预警：资金短缺可能成为 AI 发展最大瓶颈
items.title_en: Intel, Broadcom CEOs Warn Funding Shortage Could Be Biggest AI Bottleneck
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 12 日消息，据科技媒体 CNBC 今天报道，英特尔 CEO 陈立武、博通 CEO 陈福阳警告称，尽管计算基础设施需求持续超过供应能力， 但资金可能成为 AI 发展的最大瓶颈 。 陈福阳表示，随着整个行业竞相建设基础设施，融资相比半导体、存储和电力更可能成为 AI 扩张的主要障碍。 IT之家从原报道获悉，英特尔 CEO 陈立武也表达了类似担忧，他认为 AI 成本正在不断上升，且企业巨额投资 AI 后，最终能否获得足够回报仍存在疑问。 两位高管的言论凸显了 AI 行业正在面临的一项新挑战。为了应对计算能力需求的激增， 各大人工智能企业已投入巨额资金建设数据中心 、 采购先进芯片和完善电力基础设施 。 尽管担忧融资问题，两位高管仍看好短期内 AI 计算基础设施的需求。陈福阳表示：“市场对计算基础设施的需求超过了我们的供应能力。”他补充说，这种供需失衡可能持续到 2029 年，甚至延续至 2030 年。 陈立武同样表示，未来两到三年，整个行业不太可能出现明显放缓。他指出，AI 应用的普及以及对计算能力不断增长的需求，将继续推动行业发展。
items.summary_en: Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan and Broadcom CEO Hock Tan warned that funding could become the biggest bottleneck for AI development. Hock Tan said financing is more likely than semiconductors, memory, or power to hinder AI expansion. Lip-Bu Tan also questioned whether massive AI investments will yield sufficient returns. Both remain bullish on short-term demand, expecting supply-demand imbalance to persist until 2029 or 2030.
items.why_zh: 两大芯片巨头 CEO 同时预警融资瓶颈，凸显 AI 行业面临的新挑战。
items.why_en: Warnings from two chip giants' CEOs highlight a new challenge facing the AI industry.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 的数学突破可能接下来影响生物技术和制药
items.title_en: OpenAI’s math breakthrough could hit biotech and pharma next
items.summary_zh: 据 Yahoo Finance 报道，OpenAI 在数学领域取得的突破可能很快对生物技术和制药行业产生影响。该突破有望加速药物研发、分子模拟等领域的进展，表明 AI 在基础科学发现中的应用正扩展至生命科学。具体细节尚未披露，但业界预期其影响将逐步显现。
items.summary_en: OpenAI’s math breakthrough could hit biotech and pharma next Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: AI 在数学基础领域的突破可能向产业应用扩散，加速生命科学创新。
items.why_en: A breakthrough in fundamental math could spill over into industrial applications and accelerate life sciences innovation.

items.title_zh: 南亚科技：2026Q3 DRAM 平均售价环比增长超 60%，企业毛利率 85.7%
items.title_en: Nanya: DRAM ASP Up Over 60% QoQ in 2026Q3, Gross Margin 85.7%
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 12 日消息，内存制造商南亚科技 (Nanya) 今日公布 2026 年第 3 季度合并财务报告。该企业在上一季度实现 1,336.49 亿新台币 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 280.53 亿元人民币） 营业收入， 环比增长 61.9% 、同比增长 611.7%。 南亚科技的 DRAM ASP（平均销售价格）在 2026Q3 环比增长超 60%，出货容量则有小幅下降。其 企业毛利率达 85.7% ，单季提升 6.2 个百分点；营业利润率 80.0%，提升 6.3 个百分点；净利率 65.6%，提升 4.8 个百分点。 AI 基础设施已占到南亚科技整体营收的 20% 以上 ，其未来扩建皆以客户长期合约的 AI 专案为主要目标。 南亚科技新晶圆厂 2027Q1 装机，2028 年底月投片量 3 万片、2030 年底月投片量 5 万片； 新后端设施 将在 2028 年内导入 TSV、晶圆堆叠等 3DIC 技术；第 3 代 10nm 级工艺预计 2027Q1 启动送样，后续工艺均持续按计划推进。
items.summary_en: Nanya Technology reported Q3 2026 revenue of NT$133.649 billion, up 61.9% QoQ and 611.7% YoY. DRAM ASP rose over 60% QoQ, while shipments slightly declined; gross margin reached 85.7%, operating margin 80.0%, and net margin 65.6%. AI infrastructure now accounts for over 20% of revenue. Its new fab will install equipment in Q1 2027, reach 30k wafers per month by end-2028 and 50k by end-2030; 3DIC technologies like TSV will be introduced in 2028, and 3rd-gen 10nm-class process is expected to sample in Q1 2027.
items.why_zh: AI 需求推动 DRAM 价格和厂商盈利能力大幅提升，凸显存储芯片在 AI 基础设施中的关键地位。
items.why_en: AI demand is driving up DRAM prices and profits, underscoring the critical role of memory chips in AI infrastructure.

items.title_zh: There Are Still Jobs for Junior Bankers: Managing the Bots
items.title_en: There Are Still Jobs for Junior Bankers: Managing the Bots
items.summary_zh: There Are Still Jobs for Junior Bankers: Managing the Bots Bloomberg.com
items.summary_en: Bloomberg reports that despite the rise of AI and automation in banking, junior bankers are not entirely replaced; instead, their roles are shifting to managing bots. They must oversee and correct AI-generated output to ensure accuracy in deals and reports. This shows AI is transforming, not simply eliminating, entry-level finance jobs.
items.why_zh: 揭示 AI 对金融业初级岗位的影响：不是取代，而是角色转变。
items.why_en: It reveals how AI is reshaping rather than eliminating entry-level finance roles.

items.title_zh: 亿万富翁们喜爱特朗普的 AI 品牌重塑
items.title_en: Billionaires love Trump’s AI rebrand
items.summary_zh: 据 Salon 报道，亿万富翁们对特朗普在 AI 领域的品牌重塑表示欢迎。这可能涉及特朗普在 AI 政策、投资或形象上的重新包装，并因此获得科技界亿万富翁的支持。报道未披露具体细节，但指出 AI 正成为政治与财富精英共同关注的焦点。
items.summary_en: Billionaires love Trump’s AI rebrand Salon.com

items.title_zh: AI 数据中心为何动辄耗资数十亿美元
items.title_en: AI Data Centers Cost Billions to Build. This is Why
items.summary_zh: 彭博社刊文解析 AI 数据中心高昂的建设成本问题。随着生成式 AI 热潮持续，科技公司纷纷投入巨资兴建大规模算力基础设施，单个项目的投入往往以数十亿美元计。文章围绕这一现象展开，解释为何这类设施如此“烧钱”，以及这些投入对行业格局与资本开支意味着什么。对于关注 AI 基础设施、算力供给与投资回报的读者而言，这是理解当前 AI 扩张逻辑的一篇背景性报道。
items.summary_en: AI Data Centers Cost Billions to Build. This is Why Bloomberg.com
items.why_zh: 算力基础设施的巨额成本，直接决定 AI 竞赛中谁能持续投入、谁会被淘汰。
items.why_en: The huge cost of compute infrastructure determines who can keep spending in the AI race and who gets left behind.

items.title_zh: AI 泡沫要破了？投资者对 Anthropic 的天价估值发出警告
items.title_en: AI Bubble Ready to Burst? Investor Raises Alarm Over Anthropic's Sky-High Valuation
items.summary_zh: 据 TradingView 报道，有投资者对 AI 公司 Anthropic 的高得惊人的估值公开表示担忧，并质疑 AI 领域是否存在泡沫、何时可能破裂。这一警告出现在市场对 AI 企业估值持续走高的背景下，反映出部分投资者开始重新审视 AI 初创公司估值与实际业务体量之间的落差。相关讨论凸显了当前 AI 投资热潮中的风险争议。
items.summary_en: AI Bubble Ready to Burst? Investor Raises Alarm Over Anthropic's Sky-High Valuation TradingView
items.why_zh: 对头部 AI 公司估值的质疑，是市场判断 AI 投资热潮是否可持续的风向标。
items.why_en: Skepticism over a leading AI company's valuation is a bellwether for whether the AI investment boom is sustainable.

items.title_zh: 克拉默称 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 收入不可直接比较，市值蒸发 5000 亿美元
items.title_en: Jim Cramer Says OpenAI Revenue Isn’t ‘Apples to Apples’ With Anthropic, Daniel Newman Calls Debate 'Hilarious' — $500 Billion Wiped Out
items.summary_zh: 据 Yahoo Finance 报道，财经评论员 Jim Cramer 表示，将 OpenAI 的收入与 Anthropic 的收入直接对比并不“对等”，因为两者的业务模式与口径不同；分析师 Daniel Newman 则称这场争论“很搞笑”。报道同时提到，相关市场波动中约 5000 亿美元市值被抹去。这场讨论折射出市场对 AI 公司收入数据与估值合理性的高度敏感。
items.summary_en: Jim Cramer Says OpenAI Revenue Isn’t ‘Apples to Apples’ With Anthropic, Daniel Newman Calls Debate 'Hilarious' — $500 Billion Wiped Out Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: 对 AI 公司收入口径的争论与巨额市值蒸发，凸显市场对 AI 估值与业绩真实性的紧张情绪。
items.why_en: The dispute over AI revenue comparisons and the huge wipeout highlight market anxiety about AI valuations and real business performance.
